en.title: Shortest Length After Deleting AB or BB
en.description:
Each step deletes one contiguous AB or BB and joins the two remaining sides. Find the minimum length after any number of operations.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site, and missing numeric bounds are explicitly marked as site additions.
en.input: The first line contains the length n, and the second line contains the AB string; original bounds 1≤n≤200000.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 1; 1; 4. These answers have been checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Scan in order while maintaining the stack length: on a B with a non-zero length, cancel one existing character; otherwise increase the length by one.
